bagPolicy.summary: Scotiabank Saddledome does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is limited due to construction, and fans without parking permits are encouraged to use public transit or off-site parking. Parking is managed by Calgary Parking and can be paid via the MyParking app or on-site pay machines.

rideshare.note: Pick up and drop off locations can be found at the West Plaza or on 17th Ave Extensions.

concessions.note: The Scotiabank Saddledome offers a diverse range of food and beverage options, including classic concessions like popcorn and hot dogs, specialty items such as the Shorty short rib sandwich, and dietary options like vegan meals. Notable highlights include the Fireball Whisky Bar, Tacos and Tequila, and the Coca-Cola Test Kitchen with unique monthly culinary concepts.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Scotiabank Saddledome, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: In keeping with our commitment to safety and security and as a result of a thorough review of best practices in the arena industry, effective July 1, 2018, exiting and re-entering the building during events (sporting and non-sporting) will not be permitted at the Scotiabank Saddledome.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Calgary Flames and Ticketmaster Ticket Office is located on the north side of the Saddledome, located off 14th Avenue and 5th Street S.E. The Will Call is located at the main ticket office at the Northeast corner of the Scotiabank Saddledome on the day of the event.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Driving: The Scotiabank Saddledome main entrance is located on the north side of the Saddledome off 14th Avenue and 5th Street S.E.
